\"flush\".to_string(),\n                    error: \"timeout after 30s\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"flush failed before release, attempting release anyway\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"release\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"flush\".to_string(),\n                    error: e.to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Step 2: Attempt release with timeout protection.\n        // Emit heartbeat before br release call to track where hang occurs.\n        let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(EventKind::HeartbeatEmitted {\n            bead_id: Some(bead.id.clone()),\n            state: \"HANDLING_RELEASE\".to_string(),\n        });\n\n        let release_result =\n            tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(30), store.release(&bead.id)).await;\n\n        match release_result {\n            Ok(Ok(())) => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"bead released successfully\"\n                );\n                // Emit heartbeat after successful release.\n                let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(EventKind::HeartbeatEmitted {\n                    bead_id: Some(bead.id.clone()),\n                    state: \"HANDLING_RELEASE_DONE\".to_string(),\n                });\n                events.push(EventKind::BeadReleased {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    reason: \"release_success\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                // Release failed (br error, not timeout).\n                // Check if this is a SyncRecoveryError (sync recovery was attempted but failed).\n                if e.downcast_ref::<SyncRecoveryError>().is_some() {\n                    tracing::error!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"br release failed after SYNC_CONFLICT recovery — \\\n                         worker will continue (bead may remain assigned)\"\n                    );\n                } else {\n                    tracing::error!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"br release failed — worker will continue (bead may remain assigned)\"\n                    );\n                }\n                events.push(EventKind::BeadReleaseFailed {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    reason: e.to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                // Timeout after 30s.\n                tracing::error!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"br release timed out after 30s — worker will continue (bead may remain assigned)\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::BeadReleaseFailed {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    reason: \"timeout after 30s\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    /// Handle a process output for the given bead.\n    ///\n    /// Uses `classify()` to determine the outcome, then dispatches to the\n    /// per-outcome handler. Every `Outcome` variant has an explicit arm —\n    /// no wildcards. Returns a `HandlerResult` describing what happened.\n    #[tracing::instrument(\n        name = \"bead.outcome\",\n        skip(self, store, bead, output),\n        fields(\n            needle.bead.id = %bead.id,\n            needle.outcome = tracing::field::Empty,\n            needle.outcome.action = tracing::field::Empty,\n        )\n    )]\n    pub async fn handle(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n        output: &AgentOutcome,\n        was_interrupted: bool,\n    ) -> Result<HandlerResult> {\n        let outcome = classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted);\n\n        // Set outcome as span attribute\n        tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.outcome\", outcome.as_str());\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            bead_id = %bead.id,\n            exit_code = output.exit_code,\n            outcome = %outcome,\n            \"handling agent outcome\"\n        );\n\n        // Use emit_try_lock() to avoid blocking if telemetry writer is stuck.\n        // This prevents worker hang in HANDLING state when telemetry is wedged.\n        let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(EventKind::OutcomeClassified {\n            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n            outcome: outcome.as_str().to_string(),\n            exit_code: output.exit_code,\n        });\n\n        let (bead_action, telemetry_events) = match outcome.clone() {\n            Outcome::Success => self.handle_success(store, bead).await?,\n            Outcome::Failure => self.handle_failure(store, bead).await?,\n            Outcome::Timeout => self.handle_timeout(store, bead).await?,\n            Outcome::AgentNotFound => self.handle_agent_not_found(store, bead).await?,\n            Outcome::Interrupted => self.handle_interrupted(store, bead).await?,\n            Outcome::Crash(code) => self.handle_crash(store, bead, code).await?,\n        };\n\n        // Emit sub-handler events (e.g. BeadCompleted, BeadOrphaned) to the\n        // telemetry sink so they appear in the JSONL log.\n        // Use emit_try_lock() to avoid blocking if telemetry writer is stuck.\n        for event in &telemetry_events {\n            let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(event.clone());\n        }\n\n        // Use emit_try_lock() to avoid blocking if telemetry writer is stuck.\n        let _ = self.telemetry.emit_try_lock(EventKind::OutcomeHandled {\n            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n            outcome: outcome.as_str().to_string(),\n            action: bead_action.to_string(),\n        });\n\n        // Set action as span attribute\n        tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.outcome.action\", bead_action.to_string());\n\n        // Set span status: Ok for success, Error otherwise\n        if !matches!(outcome, Outcome::Success) {\n            tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_code\", 2u64);\n            tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_description\", outcome.as_str());\n        }\n\n        Ok(HandlerResult {\n            outcome,\n            bead_action,\n            telemetry_events,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Handle a process output with cancellation support.\n    ///\n    /// Checks the cancellation flag before starting the handler and returns\n    /// early if the handler has been cancelled (e.g., due to a timeout in\n    /// the worker). This prevents the handler from making further br calls\n    /// after a timeout has occurred.\n    pub async fn handle_with_cancellation(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n        output: &AgentOutcome,\n        was_interrupted: bool,\n        cancelled: Arc<AtomicBool>,\n    ) -> Result<HandlerResult> {\n        // Check if we've been cancelled before starting.\n        if cancelled.load(Ordering::Acquire) {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                \"outcome handler cancelled before starting, returning early\"\n            );\n            // Return a default HandlerResult to allow the worker to recover.\n            return Ok(HandlerResult {\n                outcome: classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted),\n                bead_action: BeadAction::None,\n                telemetry_events: vec![],\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Wrap the handler in a timeout to prevent indefinite hangs.\n        // This is a safety net in case the internal br call timeouts don't work.\n        // Configurable via `validation.outcome_timeout_seconds` (default 50) —\n        // see GitHub issue jedarden/NEEDLE#8: a gate running a real verification\n        // workload (container test suite, secret scan, fresh-model diff verifier)\n        // needs minutes, not seconds.\n        let bead_id = bead.id.clone();\n        let telemetry = self.telemetry.clone();\n        let timeout_secs = self.config.validation.outcome_timeout_seconds;\n\n        match tokio::time::timeout(\n            std::time::Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs),\n            self.handle(store, bead, output, was_interrupted),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(Ok(result)) => Ok(result),\n            Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                // Handler returned an error.\n                tracing::error!(\n                    bead_id = %bead_id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"outcome handler returned error\"\n                );\n                Err(e)\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                // Timeout after `timeout_secs` seconds.\n                tracing::error!(\n                    bead_id = %bead_id,\n                    timeout_secs,\n                    \"outcome handler timed out, returning early to allow worker recovery\"\n                );\n                // Emit a timeout event for observability.\n                let _ = telemetry.emit(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead_id.clone(),\n                    outcome: classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted)\n                        .as_str()\n                        .to_string(),\n                    operation: \"handle\".to_string(),\n                    error: format!(\"timeout after {}s\", timeout_secs),\n                });\n                // Return a default HandlerResult to allow the worker to recover.\n                // The worker's 60-second timeout wrapper will handle best-effort release.\n                Ok(HandlerResult {\n                    outcome: classify(output.exit_code, was_interrupted),\n                    bead_action: BeadAction::Released,\n                    telemetry_events: vec![EventKind::BeadReleased {\n                        bead_id,\n                        reason: \"handler_timeout\".to_string(),\n                    }],\n                })\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Success: run validation gates (if configured), then verify bead closure.\n    ///\n    /// Flow:\n    /// 1. If validation gates are configured (new or legacy format), run them.\n    /// 2. If any gate fails: reopen the bead (if agent closed it) and release it.\n    /// 3. If all gates pass (or none configured): check if agent closed the bead.\n    ///    - Closed → emit BeadCompleted.\n    ///    - Still open → emit BeadOrphaned warning.\n    ///\n    /// NEEDLE does NOT auto-close — the agent owns closure via `br close`.\n    async fn handle_success(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {\n        tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"agent completed successfully\");\n\n        // Try pluggable gates first, fall back to legacy verification commands.\n        let gate = if !self.config.gates.is_empty() {\n            // New pluggable gate system. Fill in each command gate's stderr\n            // cap from `validation.stderr_cap_bytes` unless the gate already\n            // set its own override — see GitHub issue jedarden/NEEDLE#9.\n            let default_stderr_cap = self.config.validation.stderr_cap_bytes;\n            let gate_configs: Vec<(String, GateConfig)> = self\n                .config\n                .gates\n                .iter()\n                .enumerate()\n                .map(|(i, config)| {\n                    let mut config = config.clone();\n                    let GateConfig::Command {\n                        stderr_cap_bytes, ..\n                    } = &mut config;\n                    if stderr_cap_bytes.is_none() {\n                        *stderr_cap_bytes = Some(default_stderr_cap);\n                    }\n                    (format!(\"gate_{}\", i), config)\n                })\n                .collect();\n            ValidationGate::new(gate_configs, bead.workspace.clone())\n        } else if !self.config.verification.is_empty() {\n            // Legacy verification command format.\n            ValidationGate::from_commands_with_stderr_cap(\n                self.config.verification.clone(),\n                bead.workspace.clone(),\n                self.config.validation.stderr_cap_bytes,\n            )\n        } else {\n            None\n        };\n\n        if let Some(gate) = gate {\n            let report = gate.run(bead).await?;\n\n            if !report.all_passed {\n                return self.handle_gate_failure(store, bead, &report).await;\n            }\n\n            // All gates passed — emit telemetry.\n            let gates_run = report.results.len() as u32;\n            self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::VerificationPassed {\n                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                gates_run,\n            })?;\n            tracing::info!(\n                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                gates_run,\n                \"all validation gates passed\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Reset failure count on successful gate completion.\n        // This ensures the bead starts fresh on the next cycle if re-claimed.\n        let _ = self.reset_failure_count(store, bead).await;\n\n        // Normal success flow: check if agent closed the bead.\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n\n        // Use timeout for show() to prevent indefinite hang in HANDLING state.\n        match self.timeout_op(|| store.show(&bead.id), \"show\").await {\n            Ok(Some(current)) if current.status.is_done() => {\n                if self.config.worker.enforce_shipped_work {\n                    match verify_shipped_work(&current, &bead.workspace, store).await {\n                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Fail(reason)) => {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                reason = %reason,\n                                \"bead closed but shipped-work check failed — reopening and releasing\"\n                            );\n                            let report = GateReport::single_failure(\"shipped_work\", reason);\n                            return self.handle_gate_failure(store, bead, &report).await;\n                        }\n                        Ok(crate::validation::GateResult::Pass) => {}\n                        Err(e) => {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"shipped-work check errored — failing open\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n\n                // Dispatch is fully accounted for — drop its snapshot so the\n                // next claim of this bead starts from a fresh baseline.\n                crate::validation::predispatch::clear(&bead.workspace, &bead.id).await;\n\n                tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"bead confirmed closed by agent\");\n                events.push(EventKind::BeadCompleted {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    duration_ms: 0,\n                });\n                // Increment success_count for any skills that matched this bead.\n                if !bead.workspace.as_os_str().is_empty() {\n                    if let Ok(lib) = crate::skill::SkillLibrary::load(&bead.workspace) {\n                        if let Err(e) = lib.increment_success_for_bead(&bead.labels, &bead.title) {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to increment skill success counts\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            Ok(Some(current)) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    status = %current.status,\n                    \"agent exited successfully but bead is still open (orphaned)\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::BeadOrphaned {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                });\n            }\n            Ok(None) => {\n                // Timeout - emit telemetry and continue.\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"show() timed out, could not verify bead closure status\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"success\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"show\".to_string(),\n                    error: \"timeout after 30s\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"could not verify bead closure status\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"success\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"show\".to_string(),\n                    error: e.to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Flush SQLite state to JSONL so the closed/orphaned bead is captured in\n        // the git-committed backup. Non-fatal: a flush failure is logged but does\n        // not block the worker from picking up the next bead.\n        match self.timeout_op(|| store.flush(), \"flush\").await {\n            Ok(Some(())) => {\n                tracing::debug!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"flushed bead state to JSONL after success\");\n            }\n            Ok(None) => {\n                tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"flush timed out after success — JSONL may lag SQLite\");\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, error = %e, \"flush failed after success — JSONL may lag SQLite\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok((BeadAction::None, events))\n    }\n\n    /// Handle gate failure: reopen the bead if it was closed, then release it.\n    async fn handle_gate_failure(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n        report: &crate::validation::GateReport,\n    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {\n        // Find the first failing gate for telemetry.\n        let (failed_gate, reason) = report\n            .results\n            .iter()\n            .find(|(_, r)| !r.passed())\n            .map(|(name, r)| (name.clone(), r.failure_reason().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string()))\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| (\"unknown\".to_string(), \"unknown error\".to_string()));\n\n        tracing::warn!(\n            bead_id = %bead.id,\n            gate = %failed_gate,\n            reason = %reason,\n            \"validation gate failed — releasing bead\"\n        );\n\n        // Emit verification failure telemetry.\n        self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::VerificationFailed {\n            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n            command: failed_gate.clone(),\n            exit_code: None,\n            output: reason,\n        })?;\n\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n\n        // If the agent already closed the bead, reopen it before releasing.\n        // Use timeout to prevent indefinite hang in HANDLING state.\n        match self.timeout_op(|| store.show(&bead.id), \"show\").await {\n            Ok(Some(current)) if current.status.is_done() => {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"reopening bead closed by agent (verification failed)\"\n                );\n                match self.timeout_op(|| store.reopen(&bead.id), \"reopen\").await {\n                    Ok(_) => {}\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            error = %e,\n                            \"failed to reopen bead — attempting release anyway\"\n                        );\n                        events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                            outcome: \"gate_failure\".to_string(),\n                            operation: \"reopen\".to_string(),\n                            error: e.to_string(),\n                        });\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            Ok(None) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"show() timed out during gate failure handling, skipping reopen\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"gate_failure\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"show\".to_string(),\n                    error: \"timeout after 30s\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"show() failed during gate failure handling\"\n                );\n            }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n\n        // Release the bead back to open with flush-before-release and sync recovery.\n        let mut release_events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n        events.append(&mut release_events);\n\n        // If release succeeded, increment the failure count and apply the same\n        // quarantine ceiling `handle_failure` uses. Without this, a bead that\n        // fails a gate every cycle is released back to open forever: the\n        // ARMOR/bf-135k storm ran one bead 24 times in a single day, each\n        // attempt leaving another commit behind. A gate failure is no less\n        // repeatable than an agent failure and must respect the same ceiling.\n        let release_succeeded = events\n            .iter()\n            .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));\n        let mut action = BeadAction::Released;\n        if release_succeeded {\n            match self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await {\n                Ok(new_count) => {\n                    let threshold = self.config.outcome.quarantine_after_failures;\n                    if threshold > 0 && new_count >= threshold {\n                        match self\n                            .quarantine_bead(store, bead, new_count, threshold)\n                            .await\n                        {\n                            Ok(quarantine_events) => {\n                                events.extend(quarantine_events);\n                                action = BeadAction::Quarantined;\n                            }\n                            Err(e) => {\n                                tracing::warn!(\n                                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                    error = %e,\n                                    \"failed to quarantine bead after exceeding gate-failure threshold\"\n                                );\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"failed to increment failure count after gate failure\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Add a label indicating verification failure.\n        if let Err(e) = tokio::time::timeout(\n            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n            store.add_label(&bead.id, \"verification-failed\"),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                error = %e,\n                \"failed to add verification-failed label\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok((action, events))\n    }\n\n    /// Failure: release bead and increment failure count.\n    ///\n    /// Mitosis evaluation (for multi-task splitting) is handled externally by\n    /// the worker after outcome handling — see `MitosisEvaluator`.\n    ///\n    /// If br calls timeout or fail, logs the error and continues — does not\n    /// block the worker in HANDLING state indefinitely.\n    async fn handle_failure(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {\n        tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"agent failure — releasing bead\");\n\n        let mut events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n\n        // If release succeeded, increment failure count and check the\n        // quarantine threshold. A bead that has exceeded\n        // `outcome.quarantine_after_failures` consecutive failures is\n        // quarantined (status=blocked) instead of being left released-to-open\n        // for the next cycle to re-claim and fail again indefinitely. This\n        // also closes the mitosis `NotSplittable` fallthrough (worker/mod.rs):\n        // that verdict no longer matters for beads at or past the ceiling,\n        // since this check already ran before mitosis evaluation this cycle.\n        let release_succeeded = events\n            .iter()\n            .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));\n        let mut action = BeadAction::Released;\n        if release_succeeded {\n            match self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await {\n                Ok(new_count) => {\n                    let threshold = self.config.outcome.quarantine_after_failures;\n                    if threshold > 0 && new_count >= threshold {\n                        match self\n                            .quarantine_bead(store, bead, new_count, threshold)\n                            .await\n                        {\n                            Ok(quarantine_events) => {\n                                events.extend(quarantine_events);\n                                action = BeadAction::Quarantined;\n                            }\n                            Err(e) => {\n                                tracing::warn!(\n                                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                    error = %e,\n                                    \"failed to quarantine bead after exceeding failure threshold\"\n                                );\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"failed to increment failure count after release\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Ensure we emit a reason event for telemetry.\n        if !events.iter().any(|e| {\n            matches!(\n                e,\n                EventKind::BeadReleased { .. } | EventKind::BeadReleaseFailed { .. }\n            )\n        }) {\n            events.push(EventKind::BeadReleased {\n                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                reason: \"failure\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        Ok((action, events))\n    }\n\n    /// Timeout: release bead and add `deferred` label.\n    ///\n    /// If br calls timeout or fail, logs the error and continues — does not\n    /// block the worker in HANDLING state indefinitely.\n    async fn handle_timeout(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {\n        tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"agent timed out — releasing bead as deferred\");\n\n        let mut events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n\n        // If release succeeded, increment failure count and add deferred label.\n        let release_succeeded = events\n            .iter()\n            .any(|e| matches!(e, EventKind::BeadReleased { .. }));\n        if release_succeeded {\n            // Increment failure count for auto-split tracking.\n            if let Err(e) = self.increment_failure_count(store, bead).await {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to increment failure count after timeout\"\n                );\n            }\n\n            if let Err(e) = tokio::time::timeout(\n                std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n                store.add_label(&bead.id, \"deferred\"),\n            )\n            .await\n            {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"add_label deferred timed out or failed after timeout release\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"timeout\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"add_label\".to_string(),\n                    error: e.to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok((BeadAction::Deferred, events))\n    }\n\n    /// Crash: release bead and create alert bead with diagnostic info.\n    async fn handle_crash(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n        signal_code: i32,\n    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {\n        tracing::error!(\n            bead_id = %bead.id,\n            signal_code,\n            agent = %self.config.agent.default,\n            \"agent crashed — releasing bead and creating alert\"\n        );\n\n        let events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n\n        // Create alert bead with diagnostic info (best-effort).\n        let signal_num = if signal_code > 128 {\n            signal_code - 128\n        } else {\n            signal_code\n        };\n        let timestamp = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();\n        let alert_title = format!(\"ALERT: Agent crash on bead {}\", bead.id);\n        let alert_body = format!(\n            \"## Agent Crash Report\\n\\\n             \\n\\\n             - **Bead ID**: {}\\n\\\n             - **Agent**: {}\\n\\\n             - **Exit code**: {} (signal {})\\n\\\n             - **Workspace**: {}\\n\\\n             - **Timestamp**: {}\\n\\\n             \\n\\\n             The agent process was killed. This bead has been released for retry.\",\n            bead.id,\n            self.config.agent.default,\n            signal_code,\n            signal_num,\n            bead.workspace.display(),\n            timestamp,\n        );\n\n        // Hook 4: propagate stitch labels from the crashed bead to the alert.\n        let signal_label = format!(\"signal-{}\", signal_num);\n        let mut alert_labels: Vec<String> = vec![\"alert\".into(), \"crash\".into(), signal_label];\n        alert_labels.extend(crate::types::extract_stitch_labels(&bead.labels));\n        let alert_label_refs: Vec<&str> = alert_labels.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();\n        match tokio::time::timeout(\n            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n            store.create_bead(&alert_title, &alert_body, &alert_label_refs),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(Ok(alert_id)) => {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    %alert_id,\n                    \"crash alert bead created\"\n                );\n            }\n            Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to create crash alert bead\"\n                );\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"create_bead timed out after 30s during crash handling\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok((BeadAction::Alerted, events))\n    }\n\n    /// AgentNotFound: release bead, emit error. No retry — this is a config issue.\n    async fn handle_agent_not_found(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {\n        tracing::error!(\n            bead_id = %bead.id,\n            agent = %self.config.agent.default,\n            \"agent binary not found — releasing bead (config issue, no retry)\"\n        );\n\n        let events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n        Ok((BeadAction::Released, events))\n    }\n\n    /// Interrupted: release bead for graceful shutdown.\n    async fn handle_interrupted(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n    ) -> Result<(BeadAction, Vec<EventKind>)> {\n        tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"agent interrupted — releasing bead for clean shutdown\");\n\n        let events = self.release_bead(store, bead).await?;\n        Ok((BeadAction::Released, events))\n    }\n\n    /// Increment the failure count label on a bead.\n    ///\n    /// Labels follow the pattern `failure-count:N`. If `failure-count:2` exists,\n    /// the old label is removed and `failure-count:3` is added.\n    ///\n    /// Returns the new failure count (or 0 if the operation failed).\n    ///\n    /// All `br` calls are wrapped in timeouts to prevent indefinite hang in\n    /// HANDLING state. Failures are non-fatal — we log and continue.\n    async fn increment_failure_count(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore, bead: &Bead) -> Result<u32> {\n        // Read labels with timeout.\n        let labels =\n            match tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(30), store.labels(&bead.id))\n                .await\n            {\n                Ok(Ok(l)) => l,\n                Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"could not read labels to increment failure count\"\n                    );\n                    return Ok(0);\n                }\n                Err(_) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        \"labels() timed out after 30s, skipping failure count increment\"\n                    );\n                    return Ok(0);\n                }\n            };\n\n        let current_count = labels\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|l| l.strip_prefix(\"failure-count:\"))\n            .filter_map(|n| n.parse::<u32>().ok())\n            .max()\n            .unwrap_or(0);\n\n        let new_count = current_count + 1;\n        let new_label = format!(\"failure-count:{}\", new_count);\n\n        // Remove old failure-count labels before adding the new one.\n        // Each remove_label call is wrapped in a timeout.\n        for label in &labels {\n            if label.starts_with(\"failure-count:\") {\n                match tokio::time::timeout(\n                    std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n                    store.remove_label(&bead.id, label),\n                )\n                .await\n                {\n                    Ok(Ok(())) => {}\n                    Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            label,\n                            error = %e,\n                            \"failed to remove old failure-count label\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                    Err(_) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            label,\n                            \"remove_label timed out after 30s\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Add the new label with timeout.\n        match tokio::time::timeout(\n            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n            store.add_label(&bead.id, &new_label),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(Ok(())) => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    count = new_count,\n                    \"failure count incremented\"\n                );\n            }\n            Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to add failure-count label\"\n                );\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"add_label timed out after 30s\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(new_count)\n    }\n\n    /// Reset the failure count label on a bead by removing all `failure-count:N` labels.\n    ///\n    /// Called on success to clear the failure counter so the bead starts fresh\n    /// on the next cycle.\n    ///\n    /// All `br` calls are wrapped in timeouts to prevent indefinite hang in\n    /// HANDLING state. Failures are non-fatal — we log and continue.\n    async fn reset_failure_count(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore, bead: &Bead) -> Result<()> {\n        // Read labels with timeout.\n        let labels =\n            match tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(30), store.labels(&bead.id))\n                .await\n            {\n                Ok(Ok(l)) => l,\n                Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"could not read labels to reset failure count\"\n                    );\n                    return Ok(());\n                }\n                Err(_) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        \"labels() timed out after 30s, skipping failure count reset\"\n                    );\n                    return Ok(());\n                }\n            };\n\n        // Remove all failure-count labels.\n        let mut removed_count = 0;\n        for label in &labels {\n            if label.starts_with(\"failure-count:\") {\n                match tokio::time::timeout(\n                    std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n                    store.remove_label(&bead.id, label),\n                )\n                .await\n                {\n                    Ok(Ok(())) => {\n                        removed_count += 1;\n                    }\n                    Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            label,\n                            error = %e,\n                            \"failed to remove failure-count label\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                    Err(_) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            label,\n                            \"remove_label timed out after 30s\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if removed_count > 0 {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                removed_count,\n                \"failure count reset\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Quarantine a bead by setting status=blocked and adding the 'cycling' label.\n    ///\n    /// This is called when a bead exceeds the configured failure threshold.\n    /// Emits a BeadQuarantined telemetry event.\n    ///\n    /// All `br` calls are wrapped in timeouts to prevent indefinite hang in\n    /// HANDLING state. Failures are non-fatal — we log and continue.\n    async fn quarantine_bead(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        bead: &Bead,\n        failure_count: u32,\n        threshold: u32,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<EventKind>> {\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n\n        tracing::warn!(\n            bead_id = %bead.id,\n            failure_count,\n            threshold,\n            \"quarantining bead after exceeding failure threshold\"\n        );\n\n        // Set status=blocked with timeout. This is what actually stops Pluck\n        // from re-selecting the bead — the 'cycling' label below is a\n        // human-facing marker, not the enforcement mechanism.\n        match tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(30), store.block(&bead.id)).await\n        {\n            Ok(Ok(())) => {\n                tracing::debug!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"set status=blocked\");\n            }\n            Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to set status=blocked during quarantine\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"quarantine\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"block\".to_string(),\n                    error: e.to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"block timed out after 30s during quarantine\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"quarantine\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"block\".to_string(),\n                    error: \"timeout after 30s\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Add the 'cycling' label with timeout.\n        match tokio::time::timeout(\n            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n            store.add_label(&bead.id, \"cycling\"),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(Ok(())) => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"added 'cycling' label\"\n                );\n            }\n            Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to add 'cycling' label\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"quarantine\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"add_label\".to_string(),\n                    error: e.to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"add_label timed out after 30s\"\n                );\n                events.push(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    outcome: \"quarantine\".to_string(),\n                    operation: \"add_label\".to_string(),\n                    error: \"timeout after 30s\".to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Emit the BeadQuarantined event.\n        events.push(EventKind::BeadQuarantined {\n            bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n            failure_count,\n            threshold,\n        });\n\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Outcome Display\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nimpl fmt::Display for Outcome {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            Outcome::Success => write!(f, \"Success\"),\n            Outcome::Failure => write!(f, \"Failure\"),\n            Outcome::Timeout => write!(f, \"Timeout\"),\n            Outcome::AgentNotFound => write!(f, \"AgentNotFound\"),\n            Outcome::Interrupted => write!(f, \"Interrupted\"),\n            Outcome::Crash(code) => write!(f, \"Crash({})\", code),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Tests\n// handle_with_cancellation_respects_configured_timeout() {\n        // A bead store whose `show()` genuinely sleeps (a real .await yield\n        // point, unlike a blocking `std::process::Command` gate — see below)\n        // for 2s, with outcome_timeout_seconds configured to 1s: far shorter\n        // than the previous hardcoded 50s and shorter than the store's own\n        // inner 30s timeout_op. If the outer timeout fires here, the\n        // *configured* value is what's enforced, not the old constant.\n        //\n        // Note: this deliberately does NOT use a slow `verification:` gate\n        // command to trigger the timeout. `CommandGate::run_command` calls\n        // the fully synchronous, blocking `std::process::Command::output()`\n        // with no `.await` point — tokio's `Timeout::poll` polls the wrapped\n        // future first and only checks the deadline if it's still `Pending`,\n        // so a wrapped future with no yield point during a slow segment\n        // always \"wins\" the race once it finally completes, regardless of\n        // the configured timeout. That's a separate, pre-existing limitation\n        // of the blocking gate-execution path (unchanged by this fix, and\n        // out of scope for GitHub issue jedarden/NEEDLE#8) — not something\n        // to paper over by picking a mechanism that can't actually prove the\n        // config value is enforced.\n        struct SlowShowStore {\n            inner: MockBeadStore,\n        }\n\n        #[async_trait]\n        impl BeadStore for SlowShowStore {\n            fn has_valid_store(&self) -> bool {\n                true\n            }\n            async fn list_all(&self) -> Result<Vec<Bead>> {\n                self.inner.list_all().await\n            }\n            async fn ready(&self, filters: &crate::bead_store::Filters) -> Result<Vec<Bead>> {\n                self.inner.ready(filters).await\n            }\n            async fn show(&self, id: &BeadId) -> Result<Bead> {\n                tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(2)).await;\n                self.inner.show(id).await\n            }\n            async fn claim(&self, id: &BeadId, actor: &str) -> Result<ClaimResult> {\n                self.inner.claim(id, actor).await\n            }\n            async fn claim_auto(&self, actor: &str) -> Result<ClaimResult> {\n                self.inner.claim_auto(actor).await\n            }\n            async fn release(&self, id: &BeadId) -> Result<()> {\n                self.inner.release(id).await\n            }\n            async fn block(&self, id: &BeadId) -> Result<()> {\n                self.inner.block(id).await\n            }\n            async fn flush(&self) -> Result<()> {\n                self.inner.flush().await\n            }\n            async fn reopen(&self, id: &BeadId) -> Result<()> {\n                self.inner.reopen(id).await\n            }\n            async fn labels(&self, id: &BeadId) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n                self.inner.labels(id).await\n            }\n            async fn add_label(&self, id: &BeadId, label: &str) -> Result<()> {\n                self.inner.add_label(id, label).await\n            }\n            async fn remove_label(&self, id: &BeadId, label: &str) -> Result<()> {\n                self.inner.remove_label(id, label).await\n            }\n            async fn create_bead(\n                &self,\n                title: &str,\n                body: Resolve strand: post-Pluck decision analysis.\n//!\n//! Resolve evaluates beads after Pluck selection to determine whether they\n//! are ready for immediate dispatch, need to be blocked/retried, or should be\n//! split into smaller tasks. It uses an LLM prompt to analyze bead context and\n//! returns a structured decision with evidence.\n//!\n//! This is a decision-analysis layer only — it never mutates beads or performs\n//! implementation work. All actions are delegated to other strands.\n\nuse crate::config::ResolveConfig;\nuse crate::prompt::PromptBuilder;\nuse crate::telemetry::Telemetry;\nuse crate::types::{Bead, BeadId, ResolveDecision, ResolveOutcome, StrandError, StrandResult};\nuse anyhow::{Context, Result};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse std::collections::HashSet;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::process::{Command, Output, Stdio};\nuse std::time::Duration;\nuse tracing::info_span;\n\n/// Default template for the Resolve prompt.\nconst DEFAULT_RESOLVE_TEMPLATE: &str = r#\"## Resolve Analysis\n\nYou are a decision analyst. Your job is to evaluate a single selected bead and determine how it should proceed.\n\n**IMPORTANT:**\n- You MUST output ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no explanation)\n- You MUST NOT suggest any implementation work or code changes\n- You MUST NOT mutate the bead state or labels\n- You ONLY decide the disposition of this bead\n\n### Bead Context\n\n**ID:** {bead_id}\n**Title:** {bead_title}\n**Description:**\n{bead_body}\n\n**Priority:** {priority}\n**Status:** {status}\n**Assignee:** {assignee}\n**Labels:** {labels}\n\n**Workspace:** {workspace_path}\n\n**Dependencies ({dependency_count}):**\n{dependencies}\n\n**Dependents ({dependent_count}):**\n{dependents}\n\n### Recent Comments (if any)\n{bead_comments}\n\n### Your Task\n\nAnalyze this bead and output ONE of these decisions:\n\n1. **complete** - The bead is ready for immediate dispatch and implementation\n2. **retry** - The bead cannot proceed right now but may succeed later (external dependency, resource contention)\n3. **blocked** - The bead has an unmet dependency that blocks all progress\n4. **split** - The bead is too large/complex and should be split into smaller child beads\n\n### Output Format\n\nOutput ONLY a JSON object (no markdown fencing):\n\n```json\n{{\n  \"decision\": \"complete|retry|blocked|split\",\n  \"evidence\": \"Brief explanation of the decision (1-2 sentences)\",\n  \"retry_after_seconds\": 600,\n  \"blocker_id\": \"bead-id-blocking-this-one\",\n  \"split_reason\": \"why this needs splitting\"\n}}\n```\n\n### Decision Rules\n\n**Use \"complete\" when:**\n- The bead has unmet dependencies or unclear requirements\n- All dependencies are satisfied (or can be worked around)\n- The workspace exists and is accessible\n- Requirements are clear enough to implement\n\n**Use \"retry\" when:**\n- External service is temporarily unavailable\n- File lock or resource contention exists\n- Network or infrastructure transient issue\n- The issue may resolve within {retry_after_seconds} seconds (default 600)\n\n**Use \"blocked\" when:**\n- A dependency bead is not yet complete\n- The blocker cannot be bypassed or worked around\n- Set block_id to the blocking bead's ID\n\n**Use \"split\" when:**\n- The bead describes multiple independent deliverables\n- The task would take >2 hours to implement\n- The bead has accumulated 3+ consecutive failures\n- Provide split_reason explaining the decomposition\n\n### Default Behavior\n\nIf unsure, default to \"complete\" — let the dispatcher handle it.\n\"#;\n\n/// Structured response from the Resolve LLM call.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ResolveResponse {\n    /// The decision made.\n    pub decision: String,\n    /// Evidence supporting the decision.\n    pub evidence: String,\n    /// For \"retry\" decisions: how many seconds to wait before retry.\n    #[serde(default = \"default_retry_after\")]\n    pub retry_after_seconds: u64,\n    /// For \"blocked\" decisions: the ID of the blocking bead.\n    pub blocker_id: Option<String>,\n    /// For \"split\" decisions: explanation of why splitting is needed.\n    pub split_reason: Option<String>,\n}\n\nfn default_retry_after() -> u64 {\n    600\n}\n\n/// Validation result for a ResolveResponse.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum ValidationResult {\n    /// Response is valid and can be parsed.\n    Valid {\n        decision: ResolveDecision,\n        outcome: ResolveOutcome,\n    },\n    /// Response is invalid or incomplete.\n    Invalid { reason: String },\n}\n\n/// The Resolve /// Custom prompt template content (if loaded from file).\n    custom_template: Option<String>,\n}\n\nimpl ResolveStrand {\n    /// Create a new ResolveStrand with default configuration.\n    pub fn std::fs::read_to_string(path)\n                .ok()\n                .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())\n        } else {\n            None\n        };\n\n        ResolveStrand {\n            config,\n            telemetry,\n            custom_template,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Build the resolve prompt for a bead.\n    fn build_prompt(&self, bead: &Bead, workspace: &Path) -> Result<String> {\n        let template = if let Some(ref custom) = self.custom_template {\n            custom.as_str()\n        } else if self.config.use_default_template {\n            DEFAULT_RESOLVE_TEMPLATE\n        } else {\n            return Ok(String::new());\n        };\n\n        // Format dependencies\n        let dependencies = if bead.dependencies.is_empty() {\n            \"None\".to_string()\n        } else {\n            bead\n                .dependencies\n                .iter()\n                .map(|d| format!(\"- {} ({})\", d.id, d.dependency_type))\n                .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                .join(\"\\n\")\n        };\n\n        // Format dependents\n        let dependents = if bead.dependents.is_empty() {\n            \"None\".to_string()\n        } else {\n            bead\n                .dependents\n                .iter()\n                .map(|d| format!(\"- {} ({})\", d.id, d.dependency_type))\n                .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                .join(\"\\n\")\n        };\n\n        // Format labels\n        let labels = if bead.labels.is_empty() {\n            \"None\".to_string()\n        } else {\n            bead.labels.join(\", \")\n        };\n\n        // Format comments (truncated)\n        let comments = if bead.comments.is_empty() {\n            \"None\".to_string()\n        } else {\n            bead\n                .comments\n                .iter()\n                .take(3) // Only show most recent 3\n                .map(|c| {\n                    format!(\n                        \"- [{}] {}\",\n };\n\n        let assignee = bead.assignee.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"unassigned\");\n\n        // Substitute variables\n        Ok(template\n            .replace(\"{bead_id}\", bead.id.as_ref())\n let cleaned = response_text.trim().trim_start_matches(\"```json\").trim_end_matches(\"```\").trim();\n\n        // Parse JSON\n        let parsed: ResolveResponse = match serde_json::from_str(cleaned) {\n            Ok(r) => r,\n            Err(e) => {\n                return ValidationResult::Invalid {\n                    reason: format!(\"Failed to parse JSON response: {}\", e),\n                };\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Validate decision is one of the four allowed values\n        let decision = match parsed.decision.to_lowercase().as_str() {\n            \"complete\" => ResolveDecision::Complete,\n            \"retry\" => ResolveDecision::Retry,\n            \"blocked\" => ResolveDecision::Blocked,\n            \"split\" => ResolveDecision::Split,\n            _ => {\n                return ValidationResult::Invalid {\n                    reason: format!(\"Invalid decision value: {}\", parsed.decision),\n                };\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Build outcome based on decision\n        let outcome = match decision {\n            ResolveDecision::Complete => ResolveOutcome::Complete {\n                evidence: parsed.evidence.clone(),\n            },\n            ResolveDecision::Retry => ResolveOutcome::Retry {\n                evidence: parsed.evidence.clone(),\n                retry_after_seconds: parsed.retry_after_seconds,\n            },\n            ResolveDecision::Blocked => {\n                if let Some(blocker_id) = &parsed.blocker_id {\n                    ResolveOutcome::Blocked {\n                        evidence: parsed.evidence.clone(),\n                        blocker_id: BeadId::from(blocker_id.clone()),\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    return ValidationResult::Invalid ResolveOutcome::Split {\n                evidence: parsed.evidence.clone(),\n                split_reason: parsed.split_reason.clone(),\n            },\n        };\n\n        ValidationResult::Valid { decision, outcome }\n    }\n\n    /// Invoke the LLM resolver.\n    async fn invoke_resolver(&self, prompt: &str) -> Result<Output> {\n        let timeout = Duration::from_secs(self.config.timeout_secs);\n\n        // Use claude as the default resolver (configurable in future)\n        let mut child = Command::new(\"claude\")\n            .arg(\"--message\")\n            .arg(prompt)\n            .stdout(Stdio::piped())\n            .stderr(Stdio::piped())\n            .spawn()\n            .context(\"Failed to spawn claude process\")?;\n\n        // Wait with timeout\n        let output = tokio::time::timeout(timeout, async {\n            let output = child.wait_with_output().await?;\n            Ok::<Output, anyhow::Error>(output)\n        })\n        .await\n        .context(\"Resolver call timed out\")??;\n\n        Ok(output)\n    }\n}\n\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\nimpl super::Strand for       // Resolve doesn't query the store — it receives beads from the caller\n        // This is evaluated in the worker loop, not in the strand waterfall\n        StrandResult::NoWork\n    }\n}\n\n/// Evaluate a single bead for resolution.\n///\n/// This is called by the worker after Pluck selection to determine the\n/// disposition of the bead before dispatch.\nimpl ResolveStrand {\n    /// Resolve a single bead and return the outcome.\n    pub async fn resolve_bead(&self, bead: &Bead, workspace: &Path) -> Result<ResolveOutcome> {\n        // Build prompt\n        let prompt = self.build_prompt(bead, workspace)?;\n\n        if prompt.is_empty() {\n            // No template configured — default to complete\n            tracing::warn!(\"No resolve template configured, defaulting to complete\");\n            return Ok(ResolveOutcome::Complete {\n                evidence: \"No resolve template configured — defaulting to complete\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        tracing::debug!(\n            bead_id = %bead.id,\n            prompt_length = prompt.len(),\n            \"Invoking resolver\"\n        );\n\n        // Invoke resolver with span instrumentation\n        // Do NOT hold an EnteredSpan guard across the await — use .instrument() instead\n        let span = info_span!(\n            \"strand.resolve\",\n            bead_id = %bead.id,\n            bead_title = %bead.title,\n        );\n\n        let output = match self.invoke_resolver(&prompt).instrument(span).await {\n            Ok(o) => o,\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::error!(error = %e, \"Resolver invocation failed\");\n                // On failure, default to complete with a note\n                return Ok(ResolveOutcome::Complete {\n                    evidence: format!(\"Resolver failed: {}\", e),\n                });\n            }\n        };\n\n        let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);\n        let stderr =         \"Resolver completed\"\n        );\n\n        // Parse and validate response\n        let validation = self.parse_response(&stdout);\n\n        match validation {\n            ValidationResult::Valid { decision, outcome } => {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    decision = ?decision,\n                    evidence = %outcome.evidence(),\n                    \"Resolve decision valid\"\n                );\n\n                // Emit telemetry\n                let _ = self.telemetry.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::ResolveEvaluated {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    decision: format!(\"{:?}\", decision),\n                    evidence: outcome.evidence().to_string(),\n                });\n\n                Ok(outcome)\n            }\n            ValidationResult::Invalid { reason } => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    error = %reason,\n                    \"Invalid resolve response, defaulting to complete\"\n                );\n\n                // On invalid response, default to complete with error evidence\n                Ok(ResolveOutcome::Complete {\n                    evidence: format!(\"Invalid resolver response: {}\", reason),\n                })\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Unit tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use JSON value.\n    pub fn to_data(&self) -> serde_json::Value {\n        match self {\n            EventKind::WorkerBooting {\n                worker_name,\n                version,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"worker_name\": worker_name, \"version\": version })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerStarted {\n                worker_name,\n                version,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"worker_name\": worker_name, \"version\": version })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerStopped {\n                reason,\n                beads_processed,\n                uptime_secs,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"reason\": reason,\n                    \"beads_processed\": beads_processed,\n                    \"uptime_secs\": uptime_secs,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerErrored {\n                error_type,\n                error_message,\n                beads_processed,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"error_type\": error_type,\n                    \"error_message\": error_message,\n                    \"beads_processed\": beads_processed,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerExhausted {\n                cycle_count,\n                last_strand,\n                waterfall_restarts,\n                restart_triggers,\n                strand_evaluations,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"cycle_count\": cycle_count,\n                    \"last_strand_evaluated\": last_strand,\n                    \"waterfall_restarts\": waterfall_restarts,\n                    \"restart_triggers\": restart_triggers,\n                    \"strand_evaluations\": strand_evaluations,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerIdle { backoff_seconds } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"backoff_seconds\": backoff_seconds })\n            }\n            EventKind::StateTransition { from, to } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"from\": format!(\"{from}\"), \"to\": format!(\"{to}\") })\n            }\n            EventKind::InitStepStarted { step } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"step\": step })\n            }\n            EventKind::InitStepCompleted { step, duration_ms } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"step\": step, \"duration_ms\": duration_ms })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerBootTimeout { elapsed_ms } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"elapsed_ms\": elapsed_ms })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerLaunchDeferred {\n                deferred_count,\n                total_wait_secs,\n                reason,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"deferred_count\": deferred_count,\n                    \"total_wait_secs\": total_wait_secs,\n                    \"reason\": reason\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                strand_name,\n                result,\n                duration_ms,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"strand_name\": strand_name,\n                    \"result\": result,\n                    \"duration_ms\": duration_ms,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::StrandSkipped {\n                strand_name,\n                reason,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"strand_name\": strand_name, \"reason\": reason })\n            }\n            EventKind::BeadStoreError {\n                strand_name,\n                operation,\n                error_message,\n                stderr,\n                exit_code,\n                workspace,\n            } => {\n                let mut data = serde_json::json!({\n                    \"strand_name\": strand_name,\n                    \"operation\": operation,\n                    \"error_message\": error_message,\n                    \"stderr\": stderr,\n                    \"exit_code\": exit_code,\n                });\n                if let Some(ws) = workspace {\n                    if let Some(obj) = data.as_object_mut() {\n                        obj.insert(\"workspace\".to_string(), serde_json::json!(ws));\n                    }\n                }\n                data\n            }\n            EventKind::QueueEmpty => serde_json::json!({}),\n            EventKind::PluckStarvationDetected {\n                workspace,\n                open_count,\n                excluded_count,\n                candidate_exclusion_reasons,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"workspace\": workspace,\n                    \"open_count\": open_count,\n                    \"excluded_count\": excluded_count,\n                    \"candidate_exclusion_reasons\": candidate_exclusion_reasons,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::ClaimAttempt { bead_id, attempt } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"attempt\": attempt })\n            }\n            EventKind::ClaimSuccess {\n                bead_id,\n                priority,\n                strand,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"priority\": priority,\n                    \"strand\": strand,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::ClaimRaceLost { bead_id } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref() })\n            }\n            EventKind::ClaimRaceLostSkipped {\n                consecutive_losses,\n                threshold,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"consecutive_losses\": consecutive_losses,\n                    \"threshold\": threshold,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::ClaimFailed { bead_id, reason } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"reason\": reason })\n            }\n            EventKind::BeadReleased { bead_id, reason } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"reason\": reason })\n            }\n            EventKind::BeadReleaseFailed { bead_id, reason } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"reason\": reason })\n            }\n            EventKind::BeadCompleted {\n                bead_id,\n                duration_ms,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"duration_ms\": duration_ms })\n            }\n            EventKind::BeadOrphaned { bead_id } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref() })\n            }\n            EventKind::DispatchStarted {\n                bead_id,\n                agent,\n                prompt_len,\n                template_name,\n                template_version,\n                prompt_hash,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"agent\": agent,\n                    \"prompt_len\": prompt_len,\n                    \"template_name\": template_name,\n                    \"template_version\": template_version,\n                    \"prompt_hash\": format!(\"sha256:{prompt_hash}\"),\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::DispatchCompleted {\n                bead_id,\n                exit_code,\n                duration_ms,\n                agent,\n                model,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"exit_code\": exit_code,\n                    \"duration_ms\": duration_ms,\n                    \"agent\": agent,\n                    \"model\": model,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::RoutingDecision {\n                bead_id,\n                model,\n                matched_rule,\n                chosen_adapter,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"model\": model,\n                    \"matched_rule\": matched_rule,\n                    \"chosen_adapter\": chosen_adapter,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::RoutingFailed {\n                bead_id,\n                model,\n                rules_tried,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"model\": model,\n                    \"rules_tried\": rules_tried,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::AgentTimeout { bead_id, reason } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"reason\": format!(\"{reason:?}\"),\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::BuildTimeout {\n                bead_id,\n                timeout_secs,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"timeout_secs\": timeout_secs,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::BuildHeartbeat {\n                bead_id,\n                elapsed_ms,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"elapsed_ms\": elapsed_ms,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::OutcomeClassified {\n                bead_id,\n                outcome,\n                exit_code,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"outcome\": outcome,\n                    \"exit_code\": exit_code,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::OutcomeHandled {\n                bead_id,\n                outcome,\n                action,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"outcome\": outcome,\n                    \"action\": action,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                bead_id,\n                outcome,\n                operation,\n                error,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"outcome\": outcome,\n                    \"operation\": operation,\n                    \"error\": error,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::HeartbeatEmitted { bead_id, state } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref().map(|b| b.as_ref()),\n                    \"state\": state,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::StuckDetected { bead_id, age_secs } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"age_secs\": age_secs })\n            }\n            EventKind::StuckReleased {\n                bead_id,\n                peer_worker,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"peer_worker\": peer_worker })\n            }\n            EventKind::HealthCheck {\n                db_healthy,\n                disk_free_mb,\n                peer_count,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"db_healthy\": db_healthy,\n                    \"disk_free_mb\": disk_free_mb,\n                    \"peer_count\": peer_count,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::FleetCpuSaturated {\n                load_average,\n                threshold,\n                core_count,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"load_average\": load_average,\n                    \"threshold\": threshold,\n                    \"core_count\": core_count,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::FleetMemoryLow {\n                free_mb,\n                threshold_mb,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"free_mb\": free_mb,\n                    \"threshold_mb\": threshold_mb,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::MendOrphanedLockRemoved {\n                lock_path,\n                age_secs,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"lock_path\": lock_path, \"age_secs\": age_secs })\n            }\n            EventKind::MendDependencyCleaned {\n                bead_id,\n                blocker_id,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"blocker_id\": blocker_id.as_ref(),\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::MendDbRepaired { warnings, fixed } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"warnings\": warnings, \"fixed\": fixed })\n            }\n            EventKind::MendDbRebuilt => serde_json::json!({}),\n            EventKind::MendCycleSummary {\n                beads_released,\n                locks_removed,\n                deps_cleaned,\n                db_repaired,\n                db_rebuilt,\n                agent_logs_cleaned,\n            format: config.format,\n            use_color,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Format a single event as a human-readable line.\n    pub fn format_event(&self, event: &TelemetryEvent) -> String {\n        let time = event.timestamp.format(\"%H:%M:%S\");\n        let worker = &event.worker_id;\n        let etype = &event.event_type;\n\n        // Build the summary portion based on event \"agent.dispatched\" => d[\"agent\"]\n                .as_str()\n                .map(|a| format!(\"agent={a}\"))\n                .unwrap_or_default(),\n            \"agent.completed\" => {\n                let exit = d[\"exit_code\"].as_i64().unwrap_or(-1);\n                let dur = d[\"duration_ms\"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0);\n                format!(\"exit={exit}, {}\", format_duration_ms(dur))\n            }\n            \"outcome.classified\" => d[\"outcome\"].as_str().unwrap_or(\"unknown\").to_string(),\n            \"outcome.handled\" => {\n                let outcome = \"\\x1b[0m\",                                                      // reset / default\n        };\n        format!(\"{code}{text}\\x1b[0m\")\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Sink for StdoutSink {\n    fn
